verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a corporate card and spend-management platform, so AI-driven GL coding is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions GL code assignment, AI categorization, or multi-entity coding. The closest items are one-click NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero sync and automated emails chasing missing memos and receipts. Those are adjacent accounting features, not automatic AI GL coding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI automatically assign GL codes to transactions across entities to accelerate close
